from pathlib import Path
source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace("go.Figure(go.Bar(", "go.Figure(go.Funnel(")
source = source.replace(
    'title="Global Trade Volume Funnel by Commodity Category (2019-2022)"',
    'title="Aid Distribution Funnel Across Implementation Stages (2015-2018)"'
)
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
print("Trace type:", fig.data[0].type)
print("Title:", fig.layout.title.text)
print("Stages:", list(fig.data[0].y))
print("Values:", list(fig.data[0].x))
print("Colors:", list(fig.data[0].marker.color))
print("Dimensions:", fig.layout.width, fig.layout.height)
print("TABLE\n", Path("table.csv").read_text())
